transientica.seo_description: Voice-controlled rhythm game using real-time ML audio classification. Beatbox sounds trigger gameplay actions with under 60ms latency.

architecture.desc: Python does the analysis. Unity runs the game. They talk via UDP/OSC.
architecture.title: Split Pipeline

ml.desc: Everyone's beatbox sounds different. The system trains on your specific voice and mic for better accuracy.
ml.title: Learns Your Voice

realtime.desc: Under 60ms latency—critical for rhythm games. Small buffers, optimized ML pipeline.
realtime.title: Low Latency

hero.description: You beatbox into the mic. The game figures out what sound you made and triggers the matching action. No controllers—just your voice and a microphone.

optimization.desc: Small audio chunks (512 samples), fast ML inference (RandomForest), and UDP-based OSC communication.
optimization.title: How I Kept It Fast

spectral.desc: Kick drums are deep. Snares have noise. I trained the system to recognize these spectral fingerprints along with temporal envelopes.
spectral.title: Spectral Analysis
